verdict.rationale: OpenCode has a GitHub integration that installs an app and Actions workflow and runs tasks in the runner when `/opencode` or `/oc` is mentioned in a comment. Its read-only plan agent can analyze code and suggest review changes without modifying files. Review is therefore possible on pull requests, but the evidence shows it is triggered by a comment rather than running automatically on every PR. missing for 10: documented automatic trigger on every PR, a dedicated PR-review mode with inline contextual comments, independent or hands-on corroboration of PR review quality.
